rows.behavior: the Correction links ADR 0055 and names kmctl review due --base
rows.fails_when: the Correction lacks the 0055 link or review due --base
rows.command: awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q '0055-one-verify-for-the-pages-a-branch-made-due' && awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q 'review due --base'

rows.behavior: the Correction gives the measured 86 and links the prototype
rows.fails_when: the Correction lacks 86 or the pr-audit-scope link
rows.command: awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q '86' && awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q 'prototypes/pr-audit-scope/README.md'

rows.behavior: the prototype holds its script and results
rows.fails_when: scope.py, results.txt or ref.txt is missing

rows.behavior: the Correction says what the audit adds over ADR 0055: whether a decision still holds
rows.fails_when: a reviewer finds no sentence telling the audit's judgment apart from 0055's list

rows.behavior: the Correction says a fork pull request is skipped with exit 0 on both jobs and publish with no report exits 0
rows.fails_when: the Correction does not say exit 0 or does not name both jobs
rows.command: awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -Eqi 'exits? 0' && awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -qi 'both'

rows.behavior: the Correction says the pull request's own workflow file runs on a pull_request event and that fetched context folders stay in the working tree
rows.command: awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -qi 'workflow file' && awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -qi 'fetched'

rows.behavior: the Correction does not claim the base checkout guards the API key
rows.fails_when: a reviewer finds the base checkout presented as guarding the key

rows.fails_when: any of the three is missing
rows.command: awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q 'okf-vs-change' && awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q 'fetch-depth: 0' && awk '/^## Correction, 2026-11-26/{c=1} c' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q '0046-kmctl-works-from-code-toward-knowledge'

rows.behavior: the accepted text above the Correction is unchanged and the record stays stable
rows.fails_when: the diff against main removes or changes an existing line, or status is not stable
rows.command: ! git diff main -- '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md' | grep -q '^-[^-]' && grep -q '^status: stable' '.okf/decisions/0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request-and-comments-on-the-decisions-it-may-have-outdated.md'

rows.behavior: the repo's pre-commit hooks pass on every file
